majors.message: no <!-- zone:... --> markers; human-read and machine/archive content are not marked (for a large document with raw material this is a Blocker)
25 lines of text come before the first panel element; the conclusion should open the document, ahead of background, provenance or reading guides
diagrams/pipeline.png is 2760 px wide; its labels shrink to a speck at 800 px - split the diagram or use fewer, larger labels
20-row table in the human zone; summarise it and move the full table to the archive

minors.message: the human zone runs to about 3331 words (advice: 2500); check that detail only some readers need has moved to the archive
no date near the title; add a line with date, author or agent, status, audience
heading 'Stage 2: Validate' is a link target but contains punctuation or emoji; its anchor may differ between viewers - use plain words and digits
shell commands in the human zone; move them to the AI-input block unless the reader must run them
heading 'Reference: settings' is a link target but contains punctuation or emoji; its anchor may differ between viewers - use plain words and digits
